team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 11 (3 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Follow the season Games & Rules packet for the chosen age group / category.
Robot construction and run scoring are physical; software is a proxy unless a simulator exists.
Do not invent field scores unsupported by the rules packet.
RoboMission General Rules 2025: team of 2 or 3 students + coach; 1 student + coach is not a team; one category per student/team per season.
Age groups Elementary/Junior/Senior with birth-year windows.
Season publishes separate Game documents + Q&A that can extend/redefine rules; national organizers may adapt.
Robot must solve field tasks under game timing/scoring tables (category-specific).
Future Innovators / Future Engineers have their own General & Game Rules on the season page.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain
duties: Direct who answers and stop teammates from talking over each other.
Give the team's official answer once the group has settled.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: primary solver
duties: Produce the first full attempt at the problem.
Show the reasoning so a teammate can check it.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: secondary solver
duties: Attack the problem from a different angle than the primary solver.
Compare results and surface the disagreement early.

answer_format: Submit the complete team deliverable requested by the problem statement.
rules_text: World Robot Olympiad. The team of 3 designs, builds, and debugs a robot solution against the season's game rules and scoring table. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official wall-clock timing is not encoded for this track; treat the turn budget as your clock and submit before it runs out. Simulation note: physical hardware and live adversaries are replaced by a scripted environment, so rely only on what the environment reports.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/
